notes.title: We're working on a new game!
notes.content:
pssst... hey you, yeah you.

We've been cooking up something we think you might like,

Announcing Kaiju Fishing!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33072170/1b3fb0df7d3f580f8d49507662d7ec54d252412c.jpg

If fishing for giant monsters sounds like fun, and honestly how could it not, Wishlist now!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33072170/08bb5b57d1d74e1f05b637fd0dd3e540a5a9097f.gif

We'll be mailing out Devblogs and recruiting playtesters from our Mailing list, and our Discord. We hope you'll join us as we bring the world of Kaiju Fishing to life.

As always, thanks for playing!

Jeff and the Mutant Studios Dev Team
